locators.note: Declares preset_id/preset_lineage (python-quality <- specdown-quality), gate_design_review_globs, product_surfaces, and adapter_review_sources. This is the declaration half of #518's declaration-to-verdict boundary: the file names surfaces without any structure binding each one to an executable reader.

The executable route that runs quality phases. #518's question is whether every surface the adapter declares reaches a phase here, and whether a declared-but-unreached surface is visible as a gap rather than absent from the final artifact.

Owns the '## Surface Contract Review' packet fields (semantic coverage, surface, owner, projections, state scope, transitions, proof boundary, unexamined axes). This is #517's existing disclosure floor, which #515 must REUSE rather than re-solve.
Final-reader tests for the surface-contract packet; the regression home for #515's routing/disclosure repair.

sha256-v2 identity binding between a verdict and its declared inputs, including the #460 working-tree/staged carve-out. #514's evidence assembly must bind through this rather than mint a second identity notion.

Executes the bounded local phases of a closeout bundle (kind charness.closeout-bundle, schema v1) and already refuses shell metacharacters in phase commands. #514's deterministic-assembly repair lands against this planner's producer coverage, runtime interpretation, and readback inputs.
Plan/execute CLI over the bundle lib; the operator-facing entrypoint whose plan output #514 requires to be deterministically reviewable before execution.
Preflight consumed by the bundle lib; part of #514's producer-coverage surface.

The only carrier that can block `git commit`. Creates a sanitized temp carrier file (`.charness-closeout-body`) BEFORE any per-issue verification runs, so protected-target authorization must be inserted ahead of that write, not after it.
Owns iter_close_keyword_refs / strip_code_fences / verify_closeout and the ledger floors. Close-keyword parsing is the shared source of truth every ingress must reuse rather than re-regex.
Pre-close draft validation reporting draft_verified; the gate the standing close approval is conditional on.
close_with_comment() performs the comment and close backend mutations. Authorization must precede BOTH, since a comment on the wrong issue is already an external side effect.

`close-with-comment` CLI. Its body carries no close keyword, so the CLI number would otherwise be self-authorizing; this is why the manual path needs an explicit repository-qualified manual_target_declaration.

Adapter resolution and, as of this slice, the issue_source_capture capability contract. The capture adapter loads this module rather than reimplementing resolution so the receipt records the same adapter identity the issue lane resolves.
ensure_release_issues_closed() path; a release-driven `gh issue close` is a bypass of the per-issue closeout floor unless it refuses protected targets first.
Builds the closeout temp message; refusal must precede temp-file creation, matching the commit-msg carrier's ordering.
Publish path reaching bump/publish/tag. Out of scope for this goal, so it must refuse protected #514/#515/#518 closes rather than silently carry them.
Resume path; a recovery entrypoint is the classic way a refusal added only to the happy path gets bypassed.
Resume-closeout path reaching issue close during recovery.
Shared release plumbing under the execute/resume paths.

non_claims: This inspection records WHICH owners were read and at what content, not that any of them is correct, complete, or repaired.
No product behavior of cmanki or craken-agents is claimed; those repos are read-only comparison evidence.
Listing a locator under an issue does not assert that issue's fix lives there; it asserts the surface was inspected while scoping that issue.
purpose: Record which producer/consumer surfaces were actually read before the #514/#515/#518 acceptance matrix was built, bound to the digest each file carried at inspection time. A locator whose digest has moved invalidates the freeze: the conclusions drawn from reading it are no longer safe to build on.
